binding_semantics: Typed instance-property reads and repeated variable references use the same matched existing instance.
IF link conditions test actual or legitimately derived links; THEN applies only to linked bindings, with no Cartesian existence obligation.
Membership is instance-set identity; = and != on bound instances compare identity.
numeric_semantics: Binary + returns a numeric sum, exact integer for two integer operands; it precedes comparisons unless parenthesized.
Existing single numeric operand, invalid missing/multiple, no string coercion and non-assignment rules remain.
status: Draft rules only; review required; no runtime change.
